questions: How many samples, Bi2Te3 islands and vortices did you measure, and how many showed the zero-bias peak? Your abstract says "MZMs are observed in all measured vortices"; the numbers behind "all" would help.
Beyond choosing "a defect-free region", how did you pick the vortices shown in Figs. 2 and 3, and were any vortices, islands or samples set aside?

Which fields, temperatures and tunneling setpoints did you measure beyond the ones shown? In particular, which fields are used in Fig. 4B-D, and did you take spectra at more than one field or tip height?
What do the spectra of the other vortices look like, for example a line cut like Fig. 3B-E through each vortex in Fig. 4B-D?

The text gives a level spacing of "about 0.7 meV", while the fits in Fig. 3G give L1 = 0.79 meV, L-1 = -0.93 meV and L2 = 1.96 meV, L-2 = -2.1 meV, a ratio near 2.3 to 2.5. How do these compare with the integer (1:2) and half-odd-integer (1:3:5) sequences, and how do you separate L2 from the inner coherence peak at 1.85 meV?

With an energy resolution of about 0.37 meV and a peak width of about 0.5 meV, what values of the gap and Fermi energy do you use for the FeTe-derived branch, and would a pair of lowest levels at plus or minus half the level spacing be resolved?
Was the 0 T spectrum in Fig. 2I taken at the same spot as the 1.0 T vortex-core spectrum, and can you rule out a vortex pinned at a subsurface interstitial Fe site in the FeTe layer?
Which data show the vortex number tuned by island size? Fig. 4E is a schematic, and Fig. 4B-D vary the field.
